summary: Widened click.edit's filename parameter to accept os.PathLike. In src/click/termui.py: added `import os`, changed both overloads and the implementation to `str | os.PathLike[str] | cabc.Iterable[str | os.PathLike[str]] | None`, wrapped filename in a one-item tuple when `isinstance(filename, (str, os.PathLike))`, and documented it (params text plus a `.. versionchanged:: 8.5.0` entry). In src/click/_termui_impl.py: `Editor.edit_files` now annotates `cabc.Iterable[str | os.PathLike[str]]`; its body already passes paths through shlex/subprocess correctly, so no logic change. Added the Unreleased CHANGES.md entry with {issue}`2869` {pr}`3781`. `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/test_termui.py` passes: 259 passed, 23 skipped.
concerns: Annotation lines were wrapped in parentheses to stay within the project's 88-column limit; confirm ruff/format accepts this style.
The CHANGES.md entry line exceeds 88 columns (matching the file's existing Markdown style, but verify if a markdown linter runs).
Editor.edit_files body was left unchanged because passing a Path to subprocess works; verify no str-only conversion is expected.
